description: Read who reshared a public post, FRESH at request time, with each resharer enriched. Costs $0.0012 per live read. Each result carries reshare_type (repost or repost_with_thoughts) and, for a with-thoughts reshare, the added commentary text. Give one of post_id, share_id or post_url. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged. Limits: no daily cap once the account has topped up; one per-account limit a minute sized to our read pool's live capacity (pricing_get people_reads.rate_limit_per_minute; over it 429 people_read_rate_limit with Retry-After, free); an account on the free signup balance only gets 100 of these reads a day (429 daily_read_limit until 00:00 UTC, free) until its first top-up.

post_id.description: The post: the post reference the posts read returns (id), its numeric activity id, or its activity, share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.

share_id.description: The post's content id: the share_id the posts read returns, a numeric id, or its share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.
